title: Snarlvine's Growing Grip
story: Snarlvine the Bog Hydra had wrapped its tentacles around a sunken wagon with a family's cat still yowling inside. Worse, every tentacle cut away caused three fresh ones to sprout in its place. A panicked farmhand had already been hacking away, and Mr 6 called for calm and counted.
question: Snarlvine started with 7 tentacles, and each cut removes 1 but grows 3 back; how many tentacles does it have after 8 cuts?
hint: Each cut removes one and adds three — so what is the net change in tentacles per cut?
victory: Mr 6 stopped the cutting, tickled the twenty-three tentacles with a reed, and Snarlvine giggled itself loose, releasing the wagon and one extremely damp cat. 'Every cut made it stronger,' he said. 'So I stopped cutting.'
imagePrompt: A misty green swamp where a many-tentacled vine hydra grips a half-sunken wagon, a numeral-six knight standing on a log holding up a reed instead of a sword.
